summary: Every mutation result carries a WorkPin, computed in its own transaction, for each work item it lists that has one: version, lifecycle, workflow type, step, live attempt, pending operator decision, and watermark. A work item without a workflow instance or a held outside-repair disposition, or one the mutation removed, has no pin, one work_pin_unavailable omission notice counts such items, and an unreadable pin otherwise refuses the mutation. next_valid_intents is derived from the pin and the workflow admission instead of hand-written literals, and continuity and the full list detail embed the same pin, so a session never reads the store around the typed surface.
title: Mutation results carry a WorkPin
